purpose: External semantic corroboration for selected V2 team-match promotion candidates. Presence here is review evidence only and does not expose a field.

statsperform_fifa_match_data_definitions.use: Direct definition support for blocked-pass / blocked-cross defensive actions.

statsperform_betting_showcase_pass_defin.use: Direct definition of chipped passes and explicit statement that Opta pass events can be categorised by defensive/middle/final-third pitch zones.

premierleague_stats_clarification.use: Official Premier League statistical vocabulary and Opta data-capture provenance, including recoveries and goal kicks.

blockedPass.note: Stats Perform explicitly distinguishes a blocked pass/cross as a defensive action when a cleanly played pass is intercepted on its intended path. Team-match aggregation still requires ordinary FRL coverage/missingness review.

totalChippedPass.note: Stats Perform explicitly defines a chipped pass as a lofted pass with an intended recipient. The source key strongly indicates the team-match count of this event type.

totalFinalThirdPasses.note: Opta documentation explicitly states that passes can be broken down by defensive, middle and final-third pitch zones. Exact aggregate inclusion semantics should be supported by empirical checks.

successfulFinalThirdPasses.proposed_label: Successful passes in the final third
successfulFinalThirdPasses.note: Final-third pass categorisation is directly supported by Opta documentation. The successful subset interpretation should be supported by a zero-violation successful<=total invariant before promotion.

ballRecovery.note: The Premier League explicitly exposes Recoveries in its Opta-derived statistical vocabulary. The field name is highly consistent with that concept, while exact aggregation still requires FRL review.

goalKicks.note: The Premier League explicitly lists goal kicks in its Opta-derived goalkeeping statistics.

touches.note: Premier League documentation states that Opta records what happens every time a player touches the ball. This supports the general touch-event concept but is not a direct definition of the team aggregate.

touchesInOppBox.note: The underlying touch-event capture is authoritative; the opposition-box qualifier remains source-name based and should be supported by touchesInOppBox<=touches empirical evidence.

governance_note: External terminology corroborates concepts but never substitutes for FRL source-field, missingness, aggregation and comparability review.
